description: This file defines the Store class in the Opencart framework, responsible for retrieving store information from the database and cache. It provides methods to get details of a store by ID, hostname, or list all stores.

classes.name: Store
classes.description: A model class managing store data retrieval within the Opencart system.

methods.name: getStore
methods.description: Retrieves store details by store ID, returns default data if ID is 0.

methods.name: getStoreByHostname
methods.description: Retrieves store details based on the store's hostname URL.

methods.name: getStores
methods.description: Retrieves all store records, utilizing caching for performance.
